results.title: Tarik
results.overview: A boy named Ridho lives a simple life alongside his father, helping him sell vegetables each day. Amid the relentless demands of daily life, he discovers a modest sense of happiness through a handmade kite. For the very first time, he possesses something that offers him true release from the burdens he carries.  Yet for his father, manhood is defined by utility being useful, capable, and needed. Consequently, flying a kite is dismissed as trivial next to the duties that lie ahead. To Ridho, however, happiness and freedom are the very essence of what he requires.  As their values collide, Ridho must navigate a choice between clinging to his newly found joy or conforming to the life his father considers best for him.

results.title: Milky Way
results.overview: A morning argument and a milk jar takes Jurgis on an unexpected journey, during which returning home becomes the greatest challenge of his life.

results.title: The Hill and Mom's Memories
results.overview: Bayu (20), a film student, returns to Tuban and invites his mother (44) to revisit places that hold memories of his parents’ love story for a college assignment. As their journey unfolds, the true reason behind his mother’s stories is slowly revealed: a message for Bayu not to repeat his father’s smoking habit, which ultimately took his life.

results.title: Bad FriENDS
results.overview: Made in under seven days for the Susto Horror Challenge.

results.title: The Power of the Newspaper: Detroit in the 1960s
results.original_title: The Power of the Newspaper: Detroit in the 1960s
results.overview: A documentary about how the Detroit Free Press covered the 1960s, a pivotal time for the media and the city of Detroit.

results.title: The Godawan
results.overview: Resurrection of the great Indian Bustard shown by stop motion film created with blue pottery.

results.title: Il-Merill
results.overview: A TV presenter slams the Maltese superhero Merill on her morning talk show, but gets an unexpected caller.

results.title: Bron Lewis - Chaos
results.overview: Bron's life is complete, utter chaos. Three kids – an emotional tweenager, a four-year old stalker and the middle one. Just when things couldn't get any harder, she bought a puppy. A million plates in the air, even more smashed on the ground around her feet. Bron wears the battle scars of an ex high-school teacher and is still reeling from the initial shock of motherhood 12 years ago. Tackling juggle-parenting, teaching, career change and flailing mental health, if you've ever thought 'if one thing goes wrong, we're all dead meat' this is the show for you.

results.title: Mallbound
results.overview: Parker Shaw is a Content Creator who makes urban exploration videos. His latest investigation took place at the old condemned mall in his hometown, where a woman named Dana Morgan took her own life. In response to internet backlash against the footage he captured, he now presents his raw files from that fateful night...

results.title: Old Fairgrounds
results.overview: The film explores how Belgrade remembers and forgets the Old Fairgrounds (Staro Sajmište), a site where suffering, art, and decades of unresolved history intertwine.

results.title: Scream 'Til You Bleed
results.overview: SCREAM 'TIL YOU BLEED is a proof-of-concept short that follows a punk band on the brink of a falling out as they travel to a remote cabin for their last show. While gearing up for the gig, their lead guitarist encounters a violent entity determined to kill everything he knows and loves.

results.title: The Mill
results.overview: A doubtful yet determined man plans on renovating an abandoned mill, where ghosts of its vanishing history linger.

results.title: Active Viewer. Passive Viewer
results.overview: A short examination of lust and porn addiction through cinematic history and inspired montage.

results.title: In the silence, they speak
results.overview: A minimalist, text-driven experiment in domestic isolation. As a ceiling fan hums and the outside world thuds, two household icons silently dissect the human myths that surround them.

results.title: Unused Documents
results.overview: A documentary following a scam victim who gathers evidence of online concert ticket fraud to get a refund. But speaking with an investigator reveals how complex justice limits her hopes for resolution.

results.title: The Expert
results.overview: Emma and Philip are both interviewing for the role of "Happiness Expert" at a company - but who deserves that position more?

results.title: Idol Seed
results.overview: An ex-FBI agent returns to a dying rural town to finish an investigation on his own terms, however, a cult begins to unravel his sense of reality.

results.title: the last straw
results.overview: During a couple's failing marriage, an old friend comes to visit, revealing something that changes everything.

results.title: Where No One Can Find Her
results.original_title: Where No One Can Find Her
results.overview: When her teen daughter Izzy is kidnapped and buried alive, Jamie and her ex-husband must put aside their differences and work together to raise a massive ransom and save Izzy from a premature grave.
